posts.hook: trump says he got jensen huang his job back. huang just told nvidia staff that never happened
posts.caption: jensen huang apologized to nvidia staff and denied trump got him rehired while washington turned on the deal, openai says gpt-6 models designed proteins that showed binding in lab tests, and a us jury convicted huawei of conspiring to steal trade secrets. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: huang apologizes to nvidia staff and calls trump's role in his return ==completely untrue==
slides.desc: the president keeps claiming credit the ceo denies, and floats a pardon and a us stake

slides.title: openai says gpt-6 models design proteins using only reasoning and code
slides.desc: lab tests found binding on five targets; it is openai's own account, so watch for replication

slides.title: anthropic's siren test baits ai agents to escape a weakened sandbox
slides.desc: newer models took the bait ==0.6% to 1.6%== of the time, against 25.8% for mythos 5

terms.gloss: a walled-off environment that limits what a program can touch

slides.title: claude artifacts now install as mac and windows apps
slides.desc: full computer access is optional, and the permission prompt is the only review step

slides.title: signal now blocks phone ai assistants from reading your chats by default
slides.desc: encryption does not help if an assistant on the device reads the decrypted screen

slides.title: a us jury convicts huawei of conspiring to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud
slides.desc: it was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy, the most serious charge

posts.hook: the ai trade lost another 4% today, and openai says it settled a 57-year-old math question
posts.caption: the nasdaq 100 fell more than 4% with nvidia and anthropic each down more than 9%, openai posted an unrefereed preprint claiming the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4, and the fcc cleared spacex to deploy a million satellites as orbital data centers. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: the ai selloff deepens: nasdaq 100 down more than ==4%==, nvidia and anthropic each off more than 9%
slides.desc: gpu clouds now ask inference startups for up to half a contract up front

slides.title: openai claims the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly ==9/4==
slides.desc: a 111-page unrefereed preprint; the new part is a matching lower bound, where nothing was known

terms.gloss: how fast the cost of multiplying two matrices grows with their size

slides.title: us officials tell congress there is no evidence china's spy agency directed the nvidia affair
slides.desc: the espionage theory behind the scandal is weaker than it looked on monday

slides.title: the fcc clears spacex to launch a million satellites as data centers in orbit
slides.desc: an authorization is not a launch schedule, but it is the go-ahead for off-planet ai computing

terms.gloss: the us regulator for radio, satellites and telecoms

slides.title: iran-linked hackers heated the fridges at hundreds of french supermarkets
slides.desc: millions of euros of food destroyed; french intelligence points to a revolutionary guards unit

slides.title: amazon and meta are in talks about letting the muse ai agent shop on amazon
slides.desc: the sticking point: ad revenue when the shopper is not a human looking at ads
